Overview

Custom Business Software, explained

Most growing businesses end up paying for a separate app for every job: one for customers, one for quotes, one for bookings, one for stock, one for staff. Each charges monthly, often per user, and each holds a piece of your data with its own default settings.

We replace that stack with one system designed around how your business actually works. Your team logs in once, information is entered once, and reports cover the whole business. Because you own the software, there are no per-user licence fees, and any developer can maintain it using the source code and documentation we hand over.

Who it's for

  • Businesses paying for several overlapping subscriptions
  • Teams re-typing the same information into different apps
  • Owners who want one view of sales, jobs, stock and staff
  • Businesses whose process doesn't fit off-the-shelf software

Why it matters

Why Custom Business Software matters for your business

Subscriptions look cheap one at a time, but they add up. A typical small business can easily end up with a CRM, an invoicing tool, a booking system, a stock app, a rostering app and a reporting add-on, each billed monthly and often per user. Every new hire increases the bill, and prices are set by vendors you don't control.

The hidden cost is time. When information lives in several apps, staff re-enter the same details, reports need exporting to spreadsheets, and nobody has one clear picture of the business. Mistakes creep in at every hand-off.

A custom system brings all of this into one place, designed around the way your team actually works. Because you own it, you decide what changes, when, and at what cost. That's why we describe it as owning your software instead of renting it.

Copying an old process into new software

Pricing

What affects the cost of Custom Business Software

  • How many parts of your business the system covers (for example sales, jobs, stock and staff)
  • How many existing tools, files or databases we need to connect or migrate
  • Number of user types and the permissions each needs
  • Whether you need a mobile app, a customer portal, or both
  • Hosting, support and new features after launch (optional)

Every quote is itemised, in AUD or USD, and valid for 30 days.

Get a fixed quote

FAQ

Custom Business Software questions

Can it replace all our current apps?

Usually most of them. We list every subscription you pay for, then design one system that covers those operations. Anything better left as a separate tool, we'll tell you.

Who owns the code?

You do. At handover you get the full source code and documentation.

What if our business changes later?

Because you own the system, it can grow with you. We or any developer can add features as your needs change.

Can you move our data from our current apps?

Yes. Data migration from your existing tools is part of the project.

Is it secure?

Yes. We build with multi-factor authentication, encryption and daily backups, following Essential Eight aligned practices.

How do we know if custom software will cost less than our subscriptions?

In your free consultation we list what you pay today and compare it with a fixed quote for one owned system, so you can see the difference in writing.

Can staff learn it easily?

Yes. Because it's designed around your process, there's less to learn. We also provide training and user guides.

Can we start small?

Yes. Many clients start with one area, such as quoting and invoicing, then add more over time.
